entities.name: Battle of Teutoburg Forest
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Arminius's destruction of three Roman legions under Varus in the Teutoburg Forest (9 CE), which permanently ended Roman attempts to conquer Germania east of the Rhine.
